_comment: 解約返戻金計算 behavioral fixture (D-2901). 解約控除 = NEWBIZ-COST × max(0,M-elapsed)/M where M=120 (GOLDEN) vs M=60 (START); 解約返戻金 = max(0, RESERVE - 解約控除), 円未満切捨て. R1..R3 have elapsed<120 (R3 elapsed 72 is >60 but <120) -> the un-amortised charge differs between the 120 and 60 bases -> CV differs (DISCRIMINATE). R4 (elapsed 6, cost>reserve) floors to CV 0 in BOTH arms (control). R5 (elapsed 130) is fully amortised -> charge 0, CV=RESERVE in both (control). R6 (status 08) is 対象外(S) in both. expect_cv are GOLDEN values. Amounts are yen; gen_text scales x100 into the COMP-3 fields.
